articles.title: The Electricity Left Over at Noon
articles.summary: A new wind farm produces more electricity than the city uses in a day, yet at suppertime its lamps still dim one after another.
articles.summaryZh: 新风场一天发出的电明明超过全城所需，晚饭时分，城里的灯却还是一盏接一盏暗下去。
storyParagraphs: After Cape City built twelve wind turbines, the mayor used the monthly report to announce that the old coal unit could close. The wind farm generated more electricity in a day than the city consumed in a day, and the coal savings would repair the docks. Lin Yue, the system dispatcher, warned that the report merely added twenty-four hours together. The mayor pointed to the final line. 'With this much left over, how could we run short?'

On the first cold evening, the sea wind stopped just before sunset. At the same moment, households turned on lights and cooked dinner while the shipyard cranes were still working. The frequency needle in the control room began to fall. Spinning machines slowed first, then the bakery's electric ovens tripped. The hospital started its own backup generator, but city hall went dark.

There truly had been surplus electricity at noon, but the warehouse had no way to keep it unchanged until evening. The retired unit could not return to full output at once. Lin called the cold store and asked it to postpone ice making, delayed one pump at the water works, and requested power from the neighbouring city through the interconnector. Only after half an hour did the needle return to the centre.

The wind farm remained the main supplier, but the city kept fast-starting reserves and added storage and better wind forecasts. Large users submitted schedules in advance, and equipment that could shift its operation received payment for pausing during tight periods. The control room no longer asked only how much electricity a day would produce. It asked where the next minute and the next hour might run short.

On another windless evening, a thousand kitchens lit at once. Lin watched the frequency needle tremble and settle between the red lines before folding the noon report marked 'electricity surplus' into a drawer.
storyParagraphsZh: 海岬城建起十二座风机后，市长拿着月报宣布旧燃煤机组可以停掉。风场一天发出的电比全城一天用的还多，省下的煤钱正好修码头。电站调度员林悦提醒，报表只把二十四小时加在一起，市长却指着最后一行说：‘多出来这么多，怎么会不够？’
第一个寒冷傍晚，海风在日落前忽然停了。与此同时，家家点灯做饭，船坞的起重机还没收工。控制室里的频率指针向下滑，纺纱机先变慢，面包房的电炉随后跳闸。医院启用了自己的备用机，市政厅却陷入黑暗。
仓库里确实有中午多发的电，却没有办法把它原样留到晚上；停掉的旧机组也来不及立刻升满功率。林悦只得电话通知冷库暂缓制冰，请水厂推迟一台泵，又让邻城通过联络线送来一部分电。半小时后，指针才回到中央。
此后，风场仍是主力，但城市保留能快速启动的备用机组，并增加储能和更准确的风况预测。耗电大户提前申报计划，可错开时段的设备在紧张时得到补偿而暂缓运行。调度室不再只问一天发了多少，还要知道下一分钟、下一小时在哪里缺多少。
又一个无风傍晚，千家厨房同时亮灯。林悦看着频率指针轻轻晃了一下，又稳在红线之间，才把午间那张写着‘电力有余’的报表折进抽屉。
explanationParagraphs: Grid balancing requires generation, imports, and storage discharge to match demand, exports, storage charging, and losses at every moment so frequency remains safe; voltage and network flows must also stay within limits. Enough total energy over a day does not guarantee enough instantaneous power. Forecasting, scheduling, reserves, interconnection, storage, and flexible demand address imbalances across different locations and timescales.
explanationParagraphsZh: 电网平衡要求发电、进口与储能放电在每一时刻匹配用电、出口、储能充电和网络损耗，使频率维持安全；电压和线路潮流也必须留在约束内。日总电量充足不代表瞬时功率充足。预测、调度、备用、互联、储能和灵活需求分别应对不同地点与时间尺度的偏差。

articles.title: The Bathhouse That Heated the Street
articles.summary: A bathhouse burns more coal each year, yet its warmest place is not the bathing pool but the snowless street outside its boiler room.
articles.summaryZh: 澡堂烧掉的煤一年比一年多，最暖的地方却不是浴池，而是锅炉房外那条积不住雪的街。
storyParagraphs: The North Street bathhouse was known for hot water. As business improved, owner Uncle Han added two cartloads of coal each day, yet the pools served only thirty per cent more people than before. The fireman said the furnace was already burning fiercely, so Han decided that only a larger furnace would be enough.

After a heavy snowfall, an apprentice noticed that snow covered the whole street except for the wet black stones outside the bathhouse. Steam escaped from old pipe joints, the hot-water tank had no lid, and thick soot lined the boiler flue. Much of the heat entered the walls, street, and chimney before any customer touched the water.

Han disliked closing for repairs and allowed only one day. Workers cleaned the flue, sealed the pipe joints, covered the tank, and used outgoing hot water to warm the incoming cold supply. The next day the pools reached the same temperature with about two-thirds of the previous coal. Han did not buy the larger furnace.

With the coal savings, he stayed open into the night and added a small pool. By the end of the month, the total number of coal carts had almost returned to its former level, but the bathhouse served twice as many people. Only by placing the two months side by side could the bookkeeper separate lower coal use per customer from the bathhouse's total consumption.

When snow fell again the next year, a white layer finally covered the stones outside the bathhouse. Han swept a narrow path, and no hidden warmth opened it further from below. Inside, the waiting benches were still full.
storyParagraphsZh: 北街澡堂以水热闻名。生意变好后，老板韩叔每天多添两车煤，浴池却只比从前多接待三成人。锅炉工说炉火已经烧到极旺，韩叔便认定再换一只更大的炉子才够。
一场大雪后，学徒发现整条街都积着雪，唯独澡堂外的石板露出湿黑颜色。蒸汽从旧管接缝往外冒，热水槽没有盖，锅炉烟道里结着厚灰。客人还没碰到热水，许多热已经进了墙、街道和烟囱。
韩叔舍不得停业检修，只同意闭门一天。工人清了烟道，补好管缝，给水槽加盖，还让排出的热水先预热冷水。第二天，浴池升到同样温度，只用了原来约三分之二的煤。韩叔没有买那只大炉子。
省下煤钱后，他把营业时间延长到夜里，又开了一个小池。月底煤场送来的总车数几乎回到从前，客人却多了一倍。账房把两个月放在一起看，才分清每位客人所用的煤减少了，而澡堂全部用煤未必同样减少。
第二年再下雪，澡堂门外终于也铺上了一层白。韩叔扫出一条窄路，雪没有从石缝下面继续融开；门里却仍坐满了等候洗澡的人。
explanationParagraphs: Energy efficiency compares useful service or output with energy input under a defined boundary and set of conditions. Reducing unwanted heat loss, friction, distribution loss, and auxiliary demand can provide the same service with less energy; appropriate metrics differ by technology. Higher efficiency does not guarantee lower total consumption because cheaper service or expansion can produce rebound. In the story, coal per customer falls while longer hours bring total coal use back up.
explanationParagraphsZh: 能源效率比较明确边界和条件下的有用服务或输出与能量输入。减少无用散热、摩擦、输送损失和辅助耗能，可用更少能量提供同样服务；不同设备需采用适合的指标。效率提高不保证总能耗下降，因为价格降低或服务扩大会带来反弹。故事中单位客人的煤耗下降，但营业扩张使总煤耗重新上升。

articles.title: The Full Reservoir That Could Not Light the Town
articles.titleZh: 装满水却点不亮灯的水库
articles.summary: An island reservoir stores a whole night of wind, yet one narrow pipe cannot carry the town through the instant its festival begins.
articles.summaryZh: 岛上的高水库存够了一夜的风，却因一根太窄的水管，没能撑过庆典开始的那一刻。
storyParagraphs: Wind Island used strong night winds to pump seawater into a mountaintop reservoir, releasing it through turbines in the evening. Before the Festival of Lamps, the island chief personally saw the water at its highest mark and promised that coloured lights, ovens, and the square's music stage could all start together. At normal demand, the stored water was enough to last until dawn.

When the festival bell rang, thousands of lamps came on at once. The reservoir remained full, but voltage across the town fell quickly. The pipe leading to the turbines could carry only a fixed flow; extra water could not squeeze through the same narrow opening. The music stage fell silent first, then the ovens went out, while the reservoir level barely moved.

The engineer started a reserve flywheel to cover the sharpest moment and asked the dock cold store to stop making ice. Once the lights were started district by district, the system recovered. She placed two cups before the chief: one was large with a pinhole in its base; the other was small and could empty at once. 'One decides how long it can serve,' she said. 'The other decides how much it can give now.'

The following year, the island added fast equipment for brief peaks, widened part of the water outlet, and kept enough stored water for long windless periods. Festival loads were staggered when forecasts were poor, and a subsea cable could call on the neighbouring island. Each measure covered the timescale it handled best.

When the festival returned, the chief did not look only at the water level. He first put a hand on the gently vibrating valve beside the outlet pipe, then gave the order to light the first row of lamps.
storyParagraphsZh: 风岛用夜里的大风把海水抽进山顶水库，傍晚再放水发电。丰灯节前，岛长亲自看见水位到了最高刻线，便答应全岛可以同时点亮彩灯、烤炉和广场乐台。那一库水按平日用量，足够支撑到天亮。
庆典钟一响，数千盏灯同时亮起。山顶水库仍然满着，城里的电压却迅速下降。通往水轮机的管道只能送出固定水量，再多的水也挤不过同一只窄口。乐台先没声，烤炉随后熄火，水库水面几乎没有下降。
工程师打开备用飞轮，让它撑过最急的片刻，又请码头冷库暂停制冰。人群分区点灯后，系统才恢复。她把两只杯子放在岛长面前：一只很大，却只有针眼般的孔；另一只很小，水能一下倒完。‘一个决定能用多久，另一个决定此刻拿得出多少。’
下一年，岛上为短时高峰增加快速装置，拓宽一部分出水能力，并保留足够水量应付长时间无风。风况不好时，庆典用电会错开，海底电缆也能向邻岛求援。每种办法只承担它擅长的那一段时间。
丰灯节再来时，岛长没有只去看水位。他先摸了摸出水管旁微微震动的阀门，随后才下令点亮第一排灯。
explanationParagraphs: Energy storage moves energy from one time to another to address mismatches between variable supply and demand. Energy capacity determines how much can be stored and for how long it can serve, while power determines the rate of charging or discharge. Efficiency, response, degradation, safety, and location also constrain value. Storage works alongside forecasting, transmission, flexible demand, and dependable supply; a large stored quantity alone does not guarantee that a peak can be met.
explanationParagraphsZh: 储能把能量从一个时刻转移到另一个时刻，用来缓解可变供给与需求的错位。容量决定可储存的能量和可支撑时长，功率决定某一时刻可充放多快；效率、响应、衰减、安全与位置也会限制价值。储能通常与预测、输电、灵活需求和可靠电源配合，不能仅凭‘存得很多’判断能否应对峰值。

articles.title: The Sluice That Was Always One Step Late
articles.summary: An orchard relies on distant messengers to report its water level, and a keeper who always moves the gate fully makes drought and flooding alternate.
articles.summaryZh: 果园靠远方信使报告水位，管水人每次都把闸门开到尽头，于是干旱和水涝轮流到来。
storyParagraphs: The river dam stood half a day's journey from the South Slope orchards. When the orchard ran dry, a rider hurried to tell the keeper at the dam. On hearing 'too low', the keeper opened the gate fully. Water needed another half day to reach the trees, and by the time the next rider returned to say 'enough', the channel was already flooding their roots.

The keeper then shut the gate completely. That decision also took a long time to show its effect downstream, and the orchard changed from flooded to cracked and dry. Within a month, peach roots first rotted and then the leaves curled. The keeper was diligently correcting the latest report each day, yet each correction pushed the level farther in the other direction.

A canal builder installed a float beside the orchard. When the water fell, it gradually opened a small local gate; as the level approached its mark, it closed the gate again. The dam's large gate no longer moved fully on a single message. When heavy rain was forecast, the orchard also warned the upstream keeper to release less water in advance.

At first the keeper disliked how gently the small gate moved and several times wanted to pull it farther himself. The builder asked him to wait through one cycle. The float moved lightly above and below its mark, then settled. No rider galloped away, and no water crossed the tree roots.
On the day the peaches ripened, the keeper shortened the long bar once used to lock the main gate and turned it into a water-level ruler beside the float.
storyParagraphsZh: 河坝离南坡果园有半日路程。果园缺水时，骑手便赶去告诉坝上的管水人；管水人一听‘太低’，就把闸门全开。水走到果园还要半日，等下一名骑手带回‘够了’，渠水已经漫过树根。
管水人于是把闸门彻底关死。可关闭的消息同样要过很久才在下游显出效果，果园又从积水变成干裂。一个月里，桃树先烂根，后卷叶。管水人每天都在认真纠正上一次的报告，却把水位推得一次比一次更远。
修渠匠在果园边装了一只浮筒，水低时它缓缓拉开本地小闸，接近刻线时又逐渐关小。河坝上的大闸不再因一句口信开到尽头；暴雨将至，果园还会提前通知上游少放一些水。
起初管水人嫌小闸动作太轻，几次想替它多拉一把。修渠匠让他等了一个来回。浮筒在刻线上下轻轻摆动，很快停稳；既没有骑手狂奔，也没有水冲过树根。
桃子成熟那天，管水人把那根曾用来锁死大闸的长杠削短，做成了浮筒旁的一根水位尺。
explanationParagraphs: Feedback control measures a system's output, compares it with a target, and adjusts the input according to the error. Excessive gain and substantial sensing or actuation delay can make correction produce overshoot and oscillation; suitable adjustment size and timely measurement improve stability. Feedforward can act in advance on measurable disturbances, while model error, noise, actuator limits, and safety constraints still matter.
explanationParagraphsZh: 反馈控制测量系统输出，与目标比较，再根据误差调整输入。增益过大、测量或执行延迟明显时，纠正可能造成过冲与振荡；较合适的调节幅度和更及时的感知有助于稳定。前馈可依据可测扰动提前动作，但模型误差、噪声、执行器限制与安全边界仍需共同考虑。

articles.title: The Horn That Amplified the Wind
articles.summary: A harbour builds a larger listening horn to hear distress bells in fog, only to turn every gust of wind into an alarm.
articles.summaryZh: 港口为听清雾中的求救铃造了一只更大的听筒，结果每一阵风都变成了警报。
storyParagraphs: Fog Harbour required a lost vessel to strike its bronze bell three times, after which the lighthouse would send a pilot boat. Winter brought stronger wind and waves, and the keeper often struggled to hear the bells. The old harbour master ordered a gigantic copper listening horn, believing that if sound became loud enough, no distress call would be missed.

On the night the horn was installed, bells did become louder. So did wind striking the rocks, chains hitting masts, and rain drumming on copper. The keeper launched the pilot boat four times and found empty sea on three trips. On the fourth call, he feared it was merely wind and waited too long; a returning fishing boat nearly struck the breakwater.

A young radio operator recorded the pitch of a real bell and the intervals between its three strokes. She placed thin reeds inside the horn that responded to that pitch and required the same timing pattern before the signal lamp was lit. The wind remained loud, but rarely matched both features together.

She did not tune the reeds to recognize only one perfect bell. A cracked bell could shift in pitch and a wave could swallow one stroke, so the acceptable range and warning threshold were set only after many foggy-night trials. False launches declined without placing genuine calls beyond an impossibly high threshold.
In spring, the harbour master removed the giant horn. He kept one ring of its copper and made it into three small bells, spaced evenly beside the watch-room door.
storyParagraphsZh: 雾港规定，迷航船只要连敲三次铜铃，灯塔就派引航艇。入冬后风浪变大，守塔人常听不清铃声。老港长命人造了一只巨大的铜听筒，觉得声音只要够响，就不会漏掉求救。
听筒装上那晚，铜铃确实响亮了，风撞礁石、铁链拍桅杆和雨点敲铜皮也一同响亮起来。守塔人一夜放出四次引航艇，三次只找到空海面。第四次他怕又是风声，迟疑了许久，回来的一艘渔船险些撞上防波堤。
年轻报务员记下真正铜铃的音高和三次敲击间隔。她在听筒里加了会随那种音高振动的薄片，并规定只有固定间隔重复出现才点亮信号灯。风仍很大，却很少同时满足那两样特征。
她也没有把薄片调得只能认一只完好的铃。断裂的铃会稍稍变音，海浪也可能吞掉一次敲击，因此范围和警戒线经过多次雾夜试验才定下。误派少了，真正的求救也没有因门槛太高被挡住。
开春后，港长拆下那只巨型听筒。他留下一圈铜边，做成三片相隔相等的小铃，挂在值班室门口。
explanationParagraphs: Signal-to-noise ratio compares desired signal power with unwanted noise power within a specified context and bandwidth, often in decibels. Amplifying both equally does not improve detectability. Filtering, matching known features, repeated averaging, coding, and reducing noise at its source can improve recognition. Practical thresholds must trade false alarms against misses, while filtering that is too narrow may reject genuine but altered signals.
explanationParagraphsZh: 信噪比比较规定情境和带宽内的目标信号功率与无用噪声功率，常以分贝表示。等比例放大信号和噪声不会改善可检测性；滤波、匹配已知特征、重复平均、编码与源头降噪可以改善辨识。实际阈值必须权衡误报和漏报，过窄的筛选也可能排除已经变形的真实信号。

articles.title: The Brake That Fell When the Air Was Lost
articles.summary: A mine cage relies on air pressure to apply its brake, until a ruptured pipe reveals which way the machine chooses when it fails.
articles.summaryZh: 矿场升降笼原本靠气压推住刹车，一根管子破裂后，众人才发现故障发生时机器会选择哪一边。
storyParagraphs: The mountain mine installed a new lift cage. In the old arrangement, a worker pulled a long lever to press the brake against the winding drum. The owner liked it because releasing the lever let the cage move again immediately. Mechanic Liang Qiu once asked, 'What happens if the air line that pulls the lever breaks?' Looking at the waiting ore carts, the owner merely told her to make the joint stronger.

On a rainy night, falling stone cut the air line. Pressure vanished, the lever relaxed, and the brake lifted away from the drum. A cage full of ore slid down two levels and stopped only after damaging the loading platform. No one was inside, but the morning shift was halted for three days. The reinforced joint remained intact; the break occurred in a different section no one had expected.

Liang reversed the brake. Weights and springs now always tried to press it against the drum, and only normal air pressure combined with a valid command could lift it. A broken line, power loss, or failed control wire would first stop the cage. Returning to service required someone to identify the cause and reset the system manually in the machine room.

The owner worried that false stops would delay production. Liang accepted that stopping had a cost. She examined the different hazards of carrying people, ore, and maintenance crews, then added position detection and regular brake trials. She did not claim every fault should make every machine do the same thing. She required each identified fault to lead first toward the less harmful state.

Six months later, another air line burst while a cage was between levels. It stopped sharply. The miners inside cursed, then waited forty minutes to be rescued. Liang hung the broken length of pipe above the brake handle and never took it down.
storyParagraphsZh: 山矿换了新的升降笼。旧设计要工人拉紧长杆，刹车片才会压住卷轮；矿主喜欢它，因为松开手，笼子便能立刻继续运行。修械师梁秋问过一句：‘若拉杆的气管断了呢？’矿主看着赶工的矿车，只让她把接头做牢些。
一个雨夜，石块擦破气管。压力瞬间消失，长杆松开，刹车也跟着离开卷轮。满载矿石的笼子向下滑了两层，撞坏装卸台才停住。笼内无人，却让早班停了三天。那只接头没有松，破的是没人预料到的另一段管子。
梁秋把刹车改了方向：重锤和弹簧平时总想把刹车压紧，只有气压正常、操作命令也正确时，刹车才会被提起。若断管、停电或控制线失效，笼子首先停下。恢复运行则要有人查明原因，再到机房手动复位。
矿主担心误停会耽误出矿。梁秋承认停机有成本，又为载人、载矿和检修分别检查了危险情形，增加了位置检测与定期试刹。她没有说所有故障都该让机器做同一件事，只要求每种故障先去往伤害较小的状态。
半年后，另一根气管在半空爆裂。升降笼猛地顿住，矿工在里面骂了几句，随后等了四十分钟才获救。梁秋把那段破管挂在刹车手柄上方，一直没有取下。
explanationParagraphs: Fail-safe design begins with specific hazards and failure modes, then defines a lower-risk state for loss of energy, broken connections, or erroneous action. In the story, springs apply the brake and air pressure releases it, so loss of energy defaults to stopping. This is not the same as continuing normal service after a fault, which is fault tolerance. Diagnostics, independent channels, interlocks, tests, and manual reset help ensure the intended safe response actually occurs.
explanationParagraphsZh: 故障安全设计先依据具体危害和故障模式，规定失能、断线、误动作等情况应进入何种较低风险状态。故事中的弹簧施加制动、气压释放制动，使失去能源时默认停车。它不等于系统在故障后仍正常服务；后者属于容错。诊断、独立通道、联锁、试验与人工复位常用于保证预定安全行为确实发生。

articles.title: The Axle That Refused to Bend
articles.summary: A cartwright chooses the axle that stays straightest under load, then learns at the first deep rut that stiffness, strength, and resistance to breaking are not the same.
articles.summaryZh: 车匠为庆典挑中一根受压时最直的车轴，却在第一处深坑前发现，直、强与不易断并不是一回事。
storyParagraphs: The county needed a four-wheeled cart to carry a bronze statue in a festival. Cartwright Shi Yuan supported three candidate axles and loaded each with the same stones. The dark, polished one barely bent, so he chose it immediately. An old blacksmith warned that the steel was extremely hard. 'If it will not even bend,' Shi replied, 'it must be the strongest.'

On festival morning, one wheel dropped into a deep rut. The loaded side of the axle made a short, sharp sound and broke cleanly. The statue hurt no one, but fell into the mud and lost the tip of its nose. The two axles Shi had called soft remained in the workshop, already straight again after their test loads were removed.

The old blacksmith made equal strips from several metals. He increased the hanging weight gradually and marked each strip's extension on a board. Under small loads, some returned completely when unloaded. Under more weight, some kept a permanent bend. Pushed further, some snapped suddenly, while others stretched a long way first. For the first time, Shi separated resistance to deformation, the point where recovery ended, and the load and deformation reached before fracture.

The new axle did not pursue hardness alone. The blacksmith chose its material and diameter for the actual loads, rounded sharp corners where force would gather, and required the crew to inspect notches before heavy journeys. There was no time to recast the statue's nose, so the magistrate ordered its missing tip turned toward the rear.

On parade day, the cart crossed the same rut. The new axle bent slightly and returned to its position after the wheel climbed out. Shi crouched beside the road, ran a finger across its reference mark, and only then waved the procession onward.
storyParagraphsZh: 县里要用四轮大车运一尊铜像参加庆典。车匠石原把三根候选车轴架起，各压上同样的石块。黑亮的那根几乎看不出弯曲，他便当场选定。老铁匠提醒这种钢太硬，石原却说：‘连弯都不弯，当然最结实。’
庆典清晨，大车一侧车轮陷进深坑。车轴受力的一边先发出短促脆响，随后整齐断开。铜像没有伤人，却侧倒在泥里，鼻尖磕掉一块。另两根被石原嫌软的车轴仍放在工棚，压过重物后早已恢复原来的直线。
老铁匠把几种金属做成同样长短的细条，一边逐渐加重，一边在木板上记下它们伸长多少。卸掉小重量，有的能完全回来；再加重，有的留下永久弯曲；继续加到最后，有的突然断，有的先拉长很远。石原第一次把‘多难变形’‘何时不再复原’和‘断前能受多少’分开看。
新车轴没有追求一味坚硬。铁匠按实际载荷选择材料和直径，磨圆原本容易聚力的尖角，又让车队在重载前检查缺口。铜像的鼻尖来不及重铸，县令只让人把缺角朝向车后。
游行那天，大车经过同一处深坑。新车轴微微弯了一下，离开坑口又回到原位。石原蹲在路边，用指尖摸过轴上的基准线，才挥手让车队继续。
explanationParagraphs: Stress describes internal force per unit area, while strain describes relative deformation. Their relationship reveals elastic stiffness, yielding, plastic deformation, hardening, and fracture. High stiffness means less deformation under a given stress; it does not guarantee high yield strength, ultimate strength, ductility, or toughness. Geometry, notch concentrations, temperature, loading rate, and material history also affect structural behaviour.
explanationParagraphsZh: 应力表示材料内部单位面积承受的内力，应变表示相对变形；两者关系揭示弹性刚度、屈服、塑性变形、硬化和断裂。刚度高只代表同一应力下变形较小，不等于屈服强度、极限强度、延性或韧性都高。结构行为还受几何、缺口造成的集中、温度、加载速度和材料历史影响。

articles.title: The Hook That Was Never Overloaded
articles.summary: A dock hook lifts only half its rated load each time, yet cracks from an old scratch after more than eight thousand lifts.
articles.summaryZh: 码头吊钩每次都只提额定重量的一半，却在第八千多次起吊时，从一道旧划痕处突然裂开。
storyParagraphs: The river port owned a massive lifting hook. Each year it raised a test weight heavier than any cargo crate, and for five years it passed. Ordinary boxes weighed less than half as much as the test piece. The dock foreman therefore felt secure. When a chain scratched a shallow line into the hook, he simply covered it with paint.

On roughly the eight-thousand-three-hundredth lift, the hook broke at that scratch just after a crate left the deck. The crate fell back into the hold and smashed a shipment of porcelain. The foreman searched every record and found no overload, so he suspected that the annual test weight had become too light.

A surveyor removed the paint and applied penetrating dye near the fracture. A fine red line extended inward from the old scratch, and the broken surface showed arcs of different shades. Each lift had advanced the crack a little. Only the small area of metal left at the end had failed suddenly under the ordinary crate.

The port stopped relying solely on one heavy annual proof. Hooks were retired according to their number of cycles; scratches and sharp features were treated promptly; high-risk areas received regular non-destructive inspection. Important loads gained a secondary catch. The foreman also recorded the sequence of loads, not only the heaviest one.
After the new hook was installed, the foreman carved a short mark on a wooden board after every hundred lifts. The painted fragment from the old hook was nailed above the first line.
storyParagraphsZh: 河港有只巨大的起重吊钩，每年都要吊起一块比货箱更重的试铁。它连续五年通过检验，平日所吊木箱还不到试铁一半。码头领班因此放心，哪怕吊钩表面被铁链划出一道浅痕，也只用油漆盖住。
第八千三百多次起吊时，木箱刚离开甲板，吊钩便从那道划痕处断开。箱子落回船舱，砸坏一批瓷器。领班翻遍记录，没有找到一次超重，便怀疑验钩的试铁做轻了。
验船师洗掉油漆，在断口附近涂上渗色液。细细的红线从旧划痕向里伸，断面上还有一圈圈不同颜色的弧纹。每一次起吊都让裂口前进一点，最后剩下的金属才在那一箱普通货物下突然断掉。
码头此后不再只做一年一次的大载荷检验。吊钩按起吊次数更换，划痕和尖角被及时处理，高风险部位定期用不伤零件的方法查裂纹；重要货物还增加第二道承接。领班也开始记录载荷先后，而不只记最重的一次。
新吊钩装上后，每完成一百次起吊，领班就在木牌上刻一道短线。旧钩那块涂过漆的断口，被钉在木牌最上方。
explanationParagraphs: Material fatigue is progressive damage caused by repeated or fluctuating loads. Cracks can initiate and grow at stresses far below those required for a single static failure. Life depends on stress amplitude, mean stress, cycle count, load sequence, surface defects, geometric concentrations, environment, and residual stress. A static proof test cannot replace cyclic testing, inspection, life management, and damage-tolerant design.
explanationParagraphsZh: 材料疲劳是反复或波动载荷造成的渐进损伤，裂纹可在远低于一次静载破坏水平的应力下萌生并扩展。寿命受应力幅、平均应力、循环次数、载荷顺序、表面缺陷、几何集中、环境与残余应力影响。静态强度试验不能替代循环试验、定期检查、寿命管理和损伤容限设计。

articles.title: The Arch Whose Every Stone Passed
articles.summary: Every arch stone from twenty workshops passes its wooden gauge, yet the final stone will not fit when the pieces meet.
articles.summaryZh: 二十家石坊交来的拱石全都通过木尺检验，合在一起时，最后一块却怎么也放不进去。
storyParagraphs: The new market arch had to stand before the autumn fair. Twenty stone yards each made one block, and the drawing allowed a hairline variation in length. An inspector checked every block with the same wooden gauge. Each fell between its two marks, received an approval stamp, and went directly to the site.

When the arch met at the top, the final keystone was a full finger too wide and could not be hammered into place. The yard owners all raised their approval stamps. Their old gauges had worn slightly, and the masons tended to leave each stone near the large side of the allowed range. A tiny excess on one block became a large accumulated error across twenty.

The market official angrily ordered every future dimension to be exact. The old master mason set down the keystone. Stone changed slightly with temperature and moisture, he said, while tools and measurements also carried error. If ornament, back faces, and joints all demanded the same precision, the fair might end before the arch was ready.

They established a shared reference line, tightened the dimensions that accumulated toward closure, and performed several trial assemblies along the way. Back surfaces and decoration that did not affect fit received wider allowances. Wooden gauges were checked against a metal master, and workshops stopped aiming consistently at one side of the range. The keystone retained enough clearance for assembly without becoming loose.

Before the fair opened, the final keystone was eased into place. The old mason did not use a hammer. He pulled away the thin wooden shim beneath it, and the stone settled with one line of daylight remaining in the joint.
storyParagraphsZh: 新市场的拱门要赶在秋集前立起。二十家石坊各做一块拱石，图纸允许长度有一线出入。验收人拿同一把木尺逐块检查，每块都在两道刻痕之间，于是盖上合格印章，直接送往工地。
拱门合到顶部时，最后的楔石宽了整整一指，怎样敲也进不去。石坊主们纷纷举起自己的合格印。原来他们的旧尺都略有磨损，工匠又习惯把石头留在允许范围偏大的一边；一块只多一点，二十块的偏差却沿拱圈加在了一起。
市监大怒，命令以后每个尺寸都必须一丝不差。老石匠却把楔石放下说，石头会因温度和湿度稍有变化，工具和测量也有误差。若所有花纹、背面和接缝都追求同样精密，秋集结束也未必做完。
他们重新找准共同基线，把会累积到闭合处的尺寸管得更严，并在中途设置几次整体样装；不影响配合的背面和装饰则放宽。木尺先与金属母尺核对，石坊也不再总把尺寸做到同一侧。楔石周围还留下足以安装、又不致松动的间隙。
秋集开门前，最后一块楔石被缓缓推入。老石匠没有用锤，只抽走了底下那片薄木垫。石块落定时，缝里还留着一线日光。
explanationParagraphs: Engineering tolerance permits controlled variation in dimensions, geometry, or performance while preserving function and manufacturability. Individually conforming parts do not guarantee a successful assembly because deviations can accumulate; process bias, gauge error, and environment also affect outcomes. Tolerances should follow functional sensitivity, fit, process capability, measurement uncertainty, and risk. Critical features may need tighter limits, while unnecessary precision elsewhere only raises cost.
explanationParagraphsZh: 工程公差允许尺寸、几何或性能在受控范围内变化，同时保证功能和可制造性。单件都合格，不代表装配一定成功，因为多个偏差可能叠加；过程偏向、量具误差和环境也会改变结果。公差应按功能敏感度、配合、过程能力、测量不确定性与风险分配，关键处收紧、非关键处无谓收紧只会增加成本。

articles.title: The Steadiest Ship Missed the Harbour
articles.summary: An owner deepens a ferry's keel and widens its hull until it resists every roll, then finds that it also resists its helmsman.
articles.summaryZh: 船主为了让渡船再也不倾斜，不断加深龙骨、加宽船身，最后它顶住了侧风，也拒绝听从舵手。
storyParagraphs: A bay ferry once rolled in cross-seas until its passengers turned pale. Owner Du Cheng swore that his next vessel would be 'as steady as the pier'. He widened the hull, placed weight low, and fitted deep fixed fins. In light waves during trials, the deck stayed level enough for a bowl of tea to remain still on a table.

On its first passenger voyage, a crosswind pushed the ship toward the edge of the channel. It barely rolled, but the helmsman could not turn the bow. The deep fins and wide hull strongly resisted yaw, while the original small rudder lacked authority at low speed. The harbour entrance slid past to starboard, and the ferry had to enter the outer bay before turning back.

A gust struck during the second approach. The helmsman applied full rudder early, but the ship delayed; when speed increased, it turned too far and scraped the dock fenders. No one was hurt, but passengers remained aboard for two extra hours. Du saw for the first time that a vessel's tendency to return toward its original motion was not the same as its ability to follow a commanded change in time.

The shipbuilder adjusted the hull, load position, and fin area, and gave the rudder sufficient authority. Trials covered empty and full loads, low speed, crosswinds, and damaged conditions. The new ship still settled after a disturbance, but no longer sacrificed steering merely to appear perfectly steady.

On the next entry, the helmsman pressed the tiller gently and the bow crossed the wind toward the harbour. When he released it, the hull gradually settled again. Du lifted the tea bowl from the table; only a small ring remained on the water.
storyParagraphsZh: 湾口渡船曾在横浪里晃得乘客脸白。船主杜成发誓下一艘船要‘稳得像码头’，便加宽船身、压低重物，又装上很深的固定鳍。试航遇到小浪时，甲板果然平稳，茶碗放在桌上都没有滑动。
真正载客那天，侧风把船推向航道边缘。船没有明显倾斜，舵手却发现船头怎样也转不过来。深鳍和宽船身强烈抗拒偏转，原来的小舵在低速时力量不足。渡船眼看着港口入口从右舷滑过去，只能驶到外湾重新掉头。
第二次靠岸又遇阵风。舵手提前打满舵，船迟迟不转，等速度起来后却突然转得太多，擦坏了码头护木。没有人受伤，乘客却在船上多困了两个时辰。杜成第一次看见，船自己回到原方向的本领，并不等于它能及时去往舵手命令的方向。
造船师重新调整船身、载重位置和鳍面，给舵留下足够力量，还分别在空载、满载、低速、横风和受损情况下试航。新船仍会在扰动后收住摆动，却不再为了追求绝对平稳而把转向能力一并拿走。
下一次进湾，舵手轻推舵柄，船头越过风向对准港口；他松开手，船身又慢慢定住。杜成把桌上的茶碗端起来，里面的水只剩一圈小波纹。
explanationParagraphs: Stability describes whether a vehicle's motion after disturbance remains bounded, decays, or returns toward an operating state. Control describes whether its actuators have enough authority and response to achieve commanded changes. Stronger passive stability can improve disturbance resistance while also increasing resistance to turning or reducing manoeuvrability. Design must examine both recovery behaviour and control authority across speeds, loads, environments, delays, and failures.
explanationParagraphsZh: 稳定性描述车辆或船舶受扰后的运动是否有界、衰减或回到运行状态；操纵性描述执行器能否以足够权限和速度实现命令变化。更强的被动稳定可能提高抗扰，也可能增加转向阻力或降低机动。设计需在不同速度、载荷、环境、延迟和故障下，同时检查恢复特性与控制能力。

articles.title: The Cargo Boat That Won the Race
articles.summary: A new cargo boat outruns every vessel in the harbour while empty, then needs two extra voyages to deliver the same grain.
articles.summaryZh: 一艘新货船在空载试航中快过全港，却为了送完同一批粮食，多跑了两趟。
storyParagraphs: Merchant Xu An wanted the royal grain contract and commissioned a long, narrow cargo boat. Its bow was sharpened like a knife and its planks polished enough to reflect a face. Empty during sea trials, it easily passed every old vessel in the harbour. Xu painted its fastest time on the sail and declared it the most economical boat for the whole route.

Under real cargo, the narrow vessel could carry only sixty per cent as many sacks while preserving draft and stability. Xu also ordered the captain to maintain trial speed, making the engine consume much more fuel. In rougher water the bow repeatedly struck the waves and the hold had to be lightened further. By the time the first grain shipment was complete, the new boat had made two extra voyages and used more fuel and crew hours.

The captain invited Xu aboard an old vessel. It travelled more slowly but carried more grain. A modest reduction in speed sharply reduced the water's resistance, increasing the number of sacks delivered per barrel of fuel. Xu finally put empty trial time, loaded consumption, number of voyages, and weather delays on the same sheet.

The shipbuilder kept a smooth hull but redesigned its beam, stern, and propeller around the usual load, allowing the engine to run at a suitable speed. The roughened hull was cleaned regularly and voyages avoided the strongest opposing current. The new measure no longer asked which boat was fastest; it asked how much fuel and time one sack required over the complete journey.
Before the next season's contract, Xu removed the racing record from the sail. A tailor made the cloth into a small flag bearing only the words: one barrel, four hundred and twenty sacks.
storyParagraphsZh: 船商许安要争下王城粮运合约，便请人造了一艘细长新船。船头削得像刀，船板打磨得能照出人影。空载试航时，它轻易超过港里所有旧船。许安把最快用时写在帆上，认为这就是全程最省的船。
真正装粮时，细船为保持吃水和稳定，只能装旧船六成的袋数。许安又命船长维持试航速度，发动机便吞下更多燃料。浪稍大，船头不断拍水，货舱也必须减载。第一批粮运完，新船多跑两趟，耗油和船员工时反而更高。
船长请他一起登上旧船。旧船速度慢些，却能装更多粮；把速度降低一小段后，水面对船身的推拒明显减轻，每桶油送到王城的粮袋增加了。许安这才把空船的竞速时间、满载油耗、航次和天气等待写到同一张表上。
造船师没有放弃流畅船形，而是按常用载荷重新调整船宽、船尾和螺旋桨，让发动机在合适速度工作。粗糙船底定期清理，航线也避开逆流最强的时段。新标准不再问哪艘船最快，而问一袋粮经过完整航程需要多少燃料与时间。
下一季签约前，许安把帆上那行竞速纪录拆了下来。裁缝用同一块布缝成一面小旗，上面只写着：一桶油，四百二十袋。
explanationParagraphs: Drag is resistance to motion through a fluid, arising from surface friction, pressure differences, flow separation, wave making, and lift-related effects. It changes with speed, shape, roughness, scale, and flow regime. Transport efficiency must be defined by useful service over a complete journey. Low empty drag or high maximum speed does not guarantee the least energy per unit of cargo because load, propulsion efficiency, stability, safety, weather, and trip count alter the result.
explanationParagraphsZh: 阻力是物体穿过流体时受到的运动抵抗，来源包括表面摩擦、压差、流动分离、造波与升力相关作用，并随速度、形状、粗糙度、尺度和流态变化。运输效率必须以有用服务和完整航程定义；低空载阻力或最高速度不保证单位货物最省，因为载荷、推进效率、稳定、安全、天气与航次都会改变结果。

articles.title: The Two Pumps That Fell Silent Together
articles.summary: A ferry owner installs two bilge pumps and believes leaks are no longer dangerous, overlooking the low-mounted switchboard they share.
articles.summaryZh: 渡船装了两台排水泵，船主以为漏水不再可怕，却没有注意它们共用同一块低处配电板。
storyParagraphs: During refurbishment, a channel ferry owner deliberately installed two bilge pumps. Whenever the surveyor asked about flooding, he slapped the deck and said, 'If one fails, there is another.' The identical pumps occupied neighbouring compartments and shared one switchboard, making maintenance convenient.

On a night crossing, driftwood split a cargo-hold seam. Soon after the first pump started, water reached the low switchboard and a short circuit cut power to both pumps. The spare pump was undamaged but equally powerless. The crew formed a bucket line and barely returned to port, with all cargo on the lower level soaked.

The owner blamed the second pump for failing to do its duty. The surveyor laid the two dead cables beside each other on a table. They were two in number, he said, but had only one fate. If a shared supply, location, cooling system, or maintenance error could defeat every copy, extra equipment offered reassurance mainly before the accident.

During the refit, one electric pump moved higher and received an independent circuit. Another could run from a diesel engine, and a manual pump remained aboard. High water sounded an alarm, check valves prevented backflow, and the crew regularly disabled one path to verify that the remaining equipment took over automatically with enough capacity. Added weight and inspection work entered the maintenance plan.

Before the ferry returned to service, the surveyor suddenly pulled the main pump fuse. The engine room went quiet for a moment, then a steady turning sound began elsewhere. The owner did not applaud. He bent down and watched the bilge level begin to fall.
storyParagraphsZh: 海峡渡船翻修时，船主特意装了两台排水泵。验船官问起进水事故，他总拍着舱板说：‘坏一台，还有一台。’两台泵型号相同，放在相邻舱位，又接到同一块配电板上，维护起来十分省事。
一次夜航中，货舱接缝被漂木撞开。第一台泵启动不久，水便淹到低处的配电板，短路同时切断两台泵。备用泵毫无损坏，却同样没有电。船员用桶接力排水，渡船勉强返回，底层货物全被泡湿。
船主责怪第二台泵没有尽责。验船官把两根断电的电缆并排放在桌上：它们数量是两根，命运却只有一条。若共同的电源、位置、冷却或维护错误能同时击中副本，多出来的设备只是在事故前看上去安心。
改装后，一台电泵移到较高舱位并使用独立电路，另一套可由柴油机驱动，船上还保留人工泵。高水位会报警，止回阀阻止倒灌，船员定期切断其中一路，确认剩余设备能够自动接手并具备足够能力。增加的重量和检查工作也被写进维护计划。
复航前，验船官突然拔掉主泵保险。机舱安静了一瞬，另一处随即传来稳定的转动声。船主没有鼓掌，只弯腰看着舱底水线开始下降。
explanationParagraphs: Safety redundancy adds components, paths, information, or capacity so a system retains a critical function or degrades in a controlled way after specified faults. Copies need sufficient capacity and should avoid common supplies, locations, designs, or maintenance that create common-cause failure. Fault detection, isolation, and reliable transfer are also necessary. Redundancy adds weight, cost, and complexity, so regular testing must show that it will actually work when needed.
explanationParagraphsZh: 安全冗余增加组件、路径、信息或能力，使系统在指定故障后仍保留关键功能或受控降级。副本必须具备足够能力，并尽量避免共同电源、位置、设计或维护造成的共因失效；还需检测故障、隔离问题并可靠切换。冗余会增加重量、成本和复杂度，因此必须通过定期试验证明它在需要时真正可用。

articles.title: The Jar That Heated Last
articles.summary: The cannery's steam gauge passes its target mark, yet a row of lids later swells because the innermost jar never heated through.
articles.summaryZh: 罐头房的蒸汽表已经越过目标刻线，仓库里却还是鼓起了一排罐盖，因为最里面那罐从未热透。
storyParagraphs: During the tomato harvest, the Luo cannery cooked ten retort loads a day. The owner watched only the temperature gauge at the top of the steam chamber. As soon as its needle reached the red line, he timed a short hold and unloaded immediately. This saved fifteen minutes per batch, and every lid appeared beautifully sealed.

Two weeks later, soft pops came from a warehouse corner as a row of lids began to swell. All the jars came from one load that had been packed most densely and had entered colder than usual. The steam gauge had not lied. It had measured heat at the top of the chamber, not the most difficult place to warm inside the tomato product.

A food technologist placed small recorders inside test jars at different positions and ran trials with full and partial loads and different starting temperatures. Jars near the door heated quickly; the coldest, thickest jar in the centre lagged far behind. She recorded not only the highest point, but the whole path of heating, holding, and cooling.

The new schedule was based on achieving the required effect at the slowest-heating location, with jar shape, fill amount, and loading pattern fixed. Critical readings were recorded for every batch and gauges were calibrated. If time, temperature, or loading deviated, the whole batch was held and handled according to a defined procedure. The cannery produced fewer loads, but no longer relied on swollen lids in storage to reveal its mistakes.

On the busiest day of the next season, the top needle had already crossed the red line. The owner's hand rested on the chamber latch until the recorder in the central test jar also lit. Only then did he open it.
storyParagraphsZh: 番茄丰收时，罗家罐头房一天要煮十锅。老板只盯着蒸汽柜顶部的温度表，指针一到红线便开始计一小会儿，随后立刻出柜。这样每锅都能快半刻钟，罐盖也全都封得漂亮。
两周后，仓库角落传来轻响，一排罐盖慢慢鼓起。那些罐头都来自同一锅，装得最密，入柜前也比平日更凉。蒸汽表没有撒谎；它只是测到柜顶的热，而不是番茄酱最难升温的那一处。
食品师把细小记录器放进不同位置的试罐，又在满柜、半柜和不同初温下各煮一回。靠近门口的罐很快达到温度，中央最稠、最冷的罐却迟了许久。她没有只记最高点，而是把整段升温、保持和冷却经过都画下来。
新程序以最慢热位置达到所需效果为准，并固定罐形、装量和摆放方式。每锅记录关键读数，温度表定期校准；若时间、温度或装载偏离，整锅先隔离，再按预先规定的办法处理。罗家少煮了几锅，却不再靠仓库里的鼓盖替自己发现错误。
下一季最忙的一天，顶部指针早已越过红线。老板的手停在开柜闩上，直到中央试罐的记录器也亮起，才把闩拉开。
explanationParagraphs: Thermal processing applies a controlled time-temperature history to achieve a specified microbial, physical, or chemical effect. Lethality accumulates across the full curve rather than depending only on peak temperature. Product viscosity, starting temperature, container, and loading pattern alter heat transfer and the cold spot. A safe schedule requires validation, routine monitoring of critical parameters, calibrated instruments, controlled cooling, and defined handling of deviating batches.
explanationParagraphsZh: 热加工通过受控的时间—温度历程取得规定的微生物、物理或化学效果，致死作用会沿完整曲线累积，并非只看峰值。产品黏度、初温、容器和装载方式会改变传热与冷点。安全程序需经验证，日常还要监测关键参数、校准仪器、控制冷却，并对偏差批次执行隔离和处置。

articles.title: The Box That Looked Drier
articles.summary: A confectioner chooses travel goods by total moisture alone; the drier-looking cake moulds while glossy preserve remains sound in its jar.
articles.summaryZh: 点心商只按总水分挑选远行货物，外表较干的糕先长了霉，亮晶晶的果酱却仍安稳地封在罐里。
storyParagraphs: A confectioner needed goods that could cross a humid strait. He touched two samples: fruit preserve was glossy and sticky, while soft cake looked much drier. A laboratory sheet also showed less total moisture in the cake. He kept the preserve in his shop and loaded a ship with cake, certain that less water meant less spoilage.

By the tenth day, white mould appeared in several cake boxes, while the preserve sample remained sound. The merchant suspected the analysis. A food technologist sealed each food in a small chamber and waited for its air and food to reach equilibrium. Air around the cake became more humid. Sugar in the preserve had not removed its water, but made much of that water less available to microorganisms.

She opened a layered pastry as well. Water from the fruit filling had moved gradually into the crisp shell, softening it and allowing mould to appear first at the seam. Adding up the moisture in the whole pastry concealed movement between its parts and did not reveal how readily the water could support growth and reactions. Higher temperature accelerated the changes.

The merchant adjusted formulation and drying, added a thin barrier between shell and filling, and selected packaging that resisted outside humidity. Each product was validated for its own acidity, sugar or salt, temperature, and intended storage period; a number borrowed from another food no longer served as a guarantee.
Before the next shipment, the merchant still touched the soft cake, but did not stamp the crate from touch alone. He waited for the needle in the small chamber to settle before sealing the first box.
storyParagraphsZh: 点心商要把货送过潮湿海峡。他摸过两种样品：果酱黏亮，软糕看起来干得多。化验纸也显示软糕所含总水分较少。于是他把果酱留在店里，装了整船软糕，认定水越少便越不容易坏。
航行第十天，几盒软糕出现白霉，果酱样品却仍好好的。商人怀疑化验错了。食品师把两种样品分别封进小室，等里面的空气与食物相互平衡。软糕周围的空气更湿；果酱里的糖虽没有让水消失，却使许多水不容易被微生物利用。
她又拆开一盒夹心酥。水果馅的水慢慢移到酥皮，皮变软，接缝处最先发霉。只把整盒水分相加，既看不见不同部分之间的迁移，也看不出哪些水更容易参与生长和反应。温度升高后，这些变化还会更快。
商人重新调整配方和干燥程度，在酥皮与馅料之间加了薄层，并选择能隔绝外界湿气的包装。每种产品都按自己的酸度、糖盐、温度和储存期限验证，不再借另一种食物的数字直接作保证。
下一次装船前，商人仍用手摸了摸软糕，却没有据此落印。他等小室里的指针停稳，才封上第一只箱子。
explanationParagraphs: Water activity expresses how available water in a food is for microbial growth, chemical reaction, and migration relative to pure water at the same temperature, and is related to equilibrium relative humidity. It differs from total moisture content. Sugar, salt, food structure, and temperature change water availability. Practical safety limits also depend on the organism, acidity, preservatives, atmosphere, packaging, and validated storage conditions.
explanationParagraphsZh: 水分活度表示食品中的水相对同温纯水有多容易参与微生物生长、化学反应和迁移，常与平衡相对湿度相联系；它不同于总水分含量。糖、盐、食品结构和温度会改变水的可利用程度。实际安全界限还取决于微生物、酸度、防腐剂、气氛、包装与经验证的储存条件。

articles.title: The Danger the Final Taste Could Not Find
articles.titleZh: 最后一口尝不出的危险
articles.summary: A pie shop entrusts safety to a final taster, until normal-tasting pies from one oven make customers at the spring fair ill.
articles.summaryZh: 肉饼坊把安全交给出炉后的试吃者，直到一炉味道正常的饼让春集上的客人接连病倒。
storyParagraphs: Before the spring fair, Chen's pie shop baked thousands of meat pies each day. At the end of the packing table, the owner stationed an experienced taster who sampled one pie from each oven load. If colour, smell, and flavour were normal, the batch received a shipping stamp. He believed anything dangerous would reveal itself in the final bite.

On one frantic day, the ice in the meat cart melted and one burner in a corner of the oven went out. The taster received a fully cooked pie from beside the oven door and found nothing unusual. Pies in the corner never reached the required centre temperature. After the fair, more than a dozen customers suffered stomach illness and all remaining stock was recalled.

The food-safety specialist did not begin by increasing the number of samples. She walked from receiving to packing and asked workers where meat could spoil, foreign material could enter, or cooked food could be contaminated again by raw-food equipment. They then identified the points where loss of control could not be reliably corrected by a later step. Cleaning, pest management, and worker hygiene became everyday foundations for the whole shop.

Receiving temperature, pie centre heating, and cooling time gained explicit limits and shift records. When a reading crossed a limit, product was held immediately and either reworked or discarded after the cause was found. Thermometers were calibrated, supervisors reviewed records, and finished-product sampling helped verify that the system worked. Tasting remained, but no longer carried dangers it could not detect.

Several months later, the same corner burner failed again. The probe reading stayed below its limit, and the whole cart received a red hold tag before reaching the packing table. The owner put down the tasting spoon and signed his name on the back of the tag.
storyParagraphsZh: 春集前，陈记肉饼坊每天出炉几千只饼。老板在包装桌末端安排一名老练试吃者，每炉随机尝一只，只要色香味正常便盖章出货。他相信坏东西总会在最后一口露出破绽。
忙乱的一天，送肉车的冰融了，烤炉角落又有一只火头熄灭。试吃者拿到的是炉门旁熟透的饼，味道毫无异常；角落那批中心温度却没有达到要求。春集后，十几名客人腹痛，剩下的货全部被召回。
受邀来的食品安全师没有先增加试吃数量，而是从收料处一路走到包装桌。她让工人指出肉可能变坏、夹入异物或被生熟器具重新污染的地方，再挑出一旦失控就无法由后续步骤可靠补救的关口。清洁、虫害管理和人员卫生则先作为全坊每天都要守的基础。
收肉温度、肉饼中心加热和冷却时间都有了明确界限与当班记录。读数越界时，产品立即隔离，查明原因后返工或丢弃；温度计定期校准，负责人还会复查记录并抽检成品，确认整套办法有效。试吃仍保留，却不再承担它发现不了的危险。
数月后，同一只角落火头再次熄灭。探针读数停在界限下方，整车肉饼还没到包装桌就被挂上红牌。老板放下试吃勺，在红牌背面签了自己的名字。
articles.conceptName: Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points
articles.conceptNameZh: 危害分析与关键控制点
explanationParagraphs: Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points is a preventive food-safety system. For a specific product and process, it identifies significant hazards, determines points where control is essential, sets validated critical limits, monitors them, and applies corrective action to deviations. Verification, records, and review show whether the system works. Prerequisite programmes such as sanitation support the plan; finished-product sampling can verify performance but cannot replace continuous process control.
explanationParagraphsZh: 危害分析与关键控制点是一套预防性食品安全体系：针对具体产品和流程识别重大危害，确定必须控制的关键点，设定经验证的限值并监测，偏离时执行纠正行动，再通过验证、记录和复核确认体系有效。清洁等前提方案支撑整个计划；成品抽检可用于验证，却无法替代过程中的持续控制。
